list.name: instance
list.query: select display_name as __text, instance_pk::text as __value from control.instance_inventory where is_active order by display_name
list.label: Instance

list.name: service_group
list.query: select distinct coalesce(service_group, '(none)') as __text, coalesce(service_group, '(none)') as __value from control.instance_inventory where is_active order by 1
list.label: Service Group

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(d.temp_files_delta), 0) as "Temp Files" from fact.pg_database_delta d join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = d.instance_pk where d.sample_ts >= now() - interval '24 hours' and (i.instance_pk::text in ($instance) or 'All' in ($instance)) and (i.service_group in ($service_group) or 'All' in ($service_group) or i.service_group is null)

select coalesce(sum(d.temp_bytes_delta), 0) as "Temp Bytes" from fact.pg_database_delta d join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = d.instance_pk where d.sample_ts >= now() - interval '24 hours' and (i.instance_pk::text in ($instance) or 'All' in ($instance)) and (i.service_group in ($service_group) or 'All' in ($service_group) or i.service_group is null)

select coalesce(round(avg(nullif(s.setting_value, '')::numeric)), 0)::text || ' ' || coalesce(max(s.unit), 'kB') as "Avg work_mem" from fact.pg_settings_snapshot s join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = s.instance_pk where s.setting_name = 'work_mem' and s.snapshot_ts = (select max(snapshot_ts) from fact.pg_settings_snapshot where setting_name = 'work_mem') and (i.instance_pk::text in ($instance) or 'All' in ($instance)) and (i.service_group in ($service_group) or 'All' in ($service_group) or i.service_group is null)

select d.instance_pk, i.display_name as instance, d.datname, coalesce(sum(d.temp_files_delta), 0) as temp_files, coalesce(sum(d.temp_bytes_delta), 0) as temp_bytes, coalesce(max(wm.setting_value), '4096') as work_mem from fact.pg_database_delta d join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = d.instance_pk left join lateral (select s.setting_value from fact.pg_settings_snapshot s where s.instance_pk = d.instance_pk and s.setting_name = 'work_mem' order by s.snapshot_ts desc limit 1) wm on true where $__timeFilter(d.sample_ts) and (i.instance_pk::text in ($instance) or 'All' in ($instance)) and (i.service_group in ($service_group) or 'All' in ($service_group) or i.service_group is null) group by d.instance_pk, i.display_name, d.datname order by temp_bytes desc

select p.instance_pk, i.display_name as instance, left(ss.query_text, 80) as query, coalesce(sum(p.temp_blks_written_delta), 0) * 8192 as temp_bytes from fact.pgss_delta p join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = p.instance_pk join dim.statement_series ss on ss.statement_series_id = p.statement_series_id where $__timeFilter(p.sample_ts) and (i.instance_pk::text in ($instance) or 'All' in ($instance)) and (i.service_group in ($service_group) or 'All' in ($service_group) or i.service_group is null) and coalesce(p.temp_blks_written_delta, 0) > 0 group by p.instance_pk, i.display_name, left(ss.query_text, 80) order by temp_bytes desc limit 30

with temp_per_instance as (select p.instance_pk, max(coalesce(p.temp_blks_written_delta, 0) * 8192) as max_temp_per_query from fact.pgss_delta p join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = p.instance_pk where $__timeFilter(p.sample_ts) and (i.instance_pk::text in ($instance) or 'All' in ($instance)) and (i.service_group in ($service_group) or 'All' in ($service_group) or i.service_group is null) group by p.instance_pk) select t.instance_pk, i.display_name as instance, coalesce(wm.setting_value, '4096') as current_work_mem, t.max_temp_per_query, case when t.max_temp_per_query > 0 then (t.max_temp_per_query / 1024)::text || 'kB' else coalesce(wm.setting_value, '4096') || 'kB (no change)' end as suggested_work_mem from temp_per_instance t join control.instance_inventory i on i.instance_pk = t.instance_pk left join lateral (select s.setting_value from fact.pg_settings_snapshot s where s.instance_pk = t.instance_pk and s.setting_name = 'work_mem' order by s.snapshot_ts desc limit 1) wm on true where t.max_temp_per_query > 0 order by t.max_temp_per_query desc
